description: Use when a user asks "what else is like this", "anything cheaper than X", "X is sold out, what instead" or "something similar that fits my room" about one product. Returns products in the same category, near the same guide price, that need no more ceiling or floor than that product where the guides state both values, best first. Each result has reasons in plain words (same type, price gap, ceiling and floor fit, capacity, folding, who it is for) and not_known for values a guide does not state. Pass max_price for cheaper options only, or same_space=false to also see bigger or taller ones. Get the id from search_home_gym_gear. buy_url is a strongsaga.com/go/ link that opens the retailer: show it to users exactly as given.

id.description: Product id from search_home_gym_gear, e.g. sg-001.

max_price.description: Only alternatives whose guide price starts at or under this USD amount.

same_space.description: true drops items known to need more ceiling or floor; false keeps them and states the difference.

user_height_in.description: User height in inches, used for treadmill and walking pad ceiling math.

name: find_home_gym_gear_alternatives
title: Find similar home gym gear
